descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S24 「Save & Extract 关掉的或留着没完成的任务的保留边界」 Retention edges for tasks closed or left open by Save & Extract

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U13 Task retention and clock: Hospital completed tasks clear at 16 h; Hospital open tasks clear 36 h after the chart was last processed; …（UAT 3.6；UAT 3.8）
  • U4 The task whose result is not dictated ('recheck weight in two weeks') stays open（UAT TC-22；TFA-92592 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident after the UAT script: two completed and two open tasks each, back-dated by the aging helper

When Read the task lists at each edge

Then Hospital: completed tasks shown at 15 h, gone at 17 h; open tasks on a chart last processed 35 h ago shown, 37 h gone. Nursing Home: open tasks still shown at 37 h and after two further visits; completed tasks at 15 h / 17 h recorded for Q12

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.6 windows ±1 h; the two-week task in Hospital is Q10. On main there is no open-task window for Hospital (convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:220-227 clears done tasks only, and no cron clears tasks), so the 37 h open-task edge is expected to fail. Nursing Home completed tasks: main clears them at 16 h (SNF_RETENTION.doneTask); recorded, not judged, until Q12 says which window applies

在哪跑：本地 manual（时间 lane，脚本代人做）；测试方法 TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-22.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；Allure 状态按分诊从 failed 改成 broken。

问题分类：票没到 ready for qa · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92592 ready for pr；TFA-94699 in progress

医院病历 37 小时没处理过，上面的未完成任务还在列表里，超过了 36 小时的窗口。

Open tasks on a Hospital chart that has not been processed for 37 hours are still listed, past the 36-hour window.

依据：allure-results/abae9225…: 7/8 pass. Hospital open tasks on a chart last processed 37 h ago are still shown: main has no Hospital open-task window (TFA-94699 in progress; TC-22 Q10 predicts this fail). Same root as the open-task cells in TC-20/S11 and TC-21/S17. NH completed-task retention is recorded only (Q12).

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane manual。

测试方法：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：manual。

本地新 lane manual：manual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（manual/plan.json，automatable: yes）：api spec. Hospital and NH, two completed tasks (doneAt now − 15 h / − 17 h) and two open tasks on charts last processed 35 h / 37 h ago; NH open task createdAt − 37 h with three visit dates. applyLifecycle; read tasks. — Deterministic server reads.

Detail:

7/8 judged cells pass (3 of them not discriminating on main), 2 recorded. Fail: Hospital: open tasks on a chart last processed 37 h ago gone (3.6 open tasks 36 h) [U13]. Recorded: Nursing Home: completed task done 15 h ago (Q12) = "present" | Nursing Home: completed task done 17 h ago (Q12) = "absent".

产品问题：Known (no Hospital open-task window on main, TFA-94699; the oracle predicts this fail). On a chart last processed 37 h ago, both open tasks are still shown.

证据：附了 3 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Reading the task lists at the 15 / 17 h and 35 / 37 h edges needs the aging helper (back-dated doneAt / processed stamps through a test-only internal mutation, called with the local stack's admin key) or a server-clock shift; dev has no admin key and its server clock cannot be moved, so this stay…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
